comment_data.body:
Thanks for the issue! This looks like a duplicate of #1906.

Having buffer closed when using completion should never be an issue coming from the buffer. There doesn't seem to be anything particularly special or hacky about `:Git commit` buffer and window.

The 'blink.cmp' does some workarounds (for dot-repeat, I believe) that affect current buffer. This was the issue previously. Maybe it regressed to this.

But in any case I don't think this is an issue with 'mini.git' per se. For example, 'mini.completion' completion works there as expected.
